name: Ultimate Security
author: ProgrammeLab

sections.description:
Ultimate Security is your all-in-one toolkit for securing WordPress websites. Designed for simplicity and control, it offers powerful modules to protect your login system, control user sessions, restrict access, and harden your site — all without relying on third-party APIs.

🔐 Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned admin, this plugin gives you a modular, lightweight, and privacy-first way to take back control of your site’s security.

🚀 Key Features

  • 🔒 Login Protection**
    • Limit login attempts and brute force protection
    • 2FA, CAPTCHA, and nonce protection
  • 👥 User Sessions**
    • Track and manage active sessions
    • Revoke sessions and force logouts
  • 🚫 Access Rules**
    • Block/allow by IP, country, or user roles
    • Maintenance mode or restricted content access
  • 🛡️ Site Hardening**
    • Disable XML-RPC, REST API, and other attack vectors
    • Prevent user enumeration and hide login URLs
  • ⚙️ Useful Utilities**
    • Enable strict headers, referrer checks, or password policies
    • Minimal dependencies, privacy-respecting
  • 🔧 Tools & Logs**
    • View login attempts, actions taken, and audit trails
    • Lightweight logging without bloating your site

Built by ProgrammeLab — specialists in secure WordPress and WooCommerce solutions.

Privacy Policy
The restricted IP, countries, etc information are stored on your server. No information is transmitted to third parties or remote server locations.
This plugin uses “http://www.geoplugin.net/php.gp?ip=” to detect users ip and restricts it by matching from your own database that you have selected You can find more about the service from the site “https://www.geoplugin.com/webservices/php”.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

  3. Go to the dashboard → “Ultimate Security” and you will find the customization options.

  4. Customize the configuration options and apply the settings.
sections.faq:
What is Ultimate Security?

Ultimate Security is a WordPress plugin that allows website admins to easily configure website security best practices.

Is Ultimate Security compatible with other WordPress themes?

Yes, Ultimate Security is compatible with most popular themes. We are continually working to ensure compatibility with even more themes to provide a seamless experience.

Is Ultimate Security for compatible with WooCommerce?

Ultimate Security is tested to work effectively with WooCommerce and its features. While we aim for complete compatibility, if you encounter any issues, our support team is available to assist you.
